lines.en: I crawl segment by segment.
My shell scrapes the ground.
Slime trails where I crawl.
My body is made of acid.
I inch forward, writhing.
My feelers probe the way.
I skirt the puddle.
A green sheen plays on my shell.

lines.zh: 我滴下的东西烧着石头。
lines.en: What I drip eats into stone.
I crawl slowly, never turning back.
My shell slips on the stone.
I pull myself into a line.
Acid drips off me.
I coil into a ring.
My feelers sway in the air.
I wait for something to come near.
My shell grows slowly.

lines.zh: 我滴下的酸在地上冒烟。
lines.en: My drip smokes on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有触须在动。
lines.en: I stay still; only my feelers move.
My body is soft, my shell hard.
I listen to the sound inside the stone.
I stretch myself out a little.
Acid pools at my shell's opening.

lines.zh: 我一节节把壳挪向另一侧。
lines.en: I shift my shell segment by segment.
I am growing my shell.
I raise my head, feelers toward you.
Your sole is smoking.
I crawl slowly; you can leave.

lines.zh: 手别下来，我的酸不讲情面。
lines.en: Keep your hand away; my acid shows no mercy.
My shell is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，闻着有点甜。
lines.en: What you hold smells a little sweet.
I don't eat you; I eat stone.
There is already acid by your feet.

lines.zh: 酸液从壳缝里漏出来了。
lines.en: Acid is leaking from my shell's seams.

lines.zh: 壳上那道裂纹通到了肉。
lines.en: That crack reaches my flesh.
The acid beads at my shell shrink.
I slide into the crack's shadow.
I slowly coil tighter.

lines.zh: 左边那根触须断了半截。
lines.en: Half of my left feeler snapped.
Shell cracked, but my slime holds.

lines.zh: 我把软肉缩回壳的最里面。
lines.en: I pull my soft flesh deep into the shell.
Is that iron?
I can eat iron.
Set it down; I'll crawl over.
My shell lacks exactly this.
I smell it.
If you don't want it, give it to me.
This is a decent size.
I'm so hungry my shell has gone soft.
Keep clear; don't get splashed.
You stepped on me and I recoiled.
My shell is slick.
I dripped acid everywhere.
Don't grind me underfoot.
I crawl to the edge of your shoe.
I got flipped onto my back.

lines.zh: 我的触须碰到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My feelers touch your ankle.
You step back; I crawl away.
I leave a trail on the ground.
My kind splits to reproduce.
My shell has just grown.
Don't touch my soft part.
I have coiled up.
I am only a worm.
I'm off to find edible stone.
I crawl aside; my acid would burn you.
My acid would hurt you.
This stone is too dry for that.
I slip into a crack.
This piece is rusty; I can chew it.

lines.zh: 这块铁太沉，我拖得壳疼。
lines.en: This iron is too heavy; dragging it hurts my shell.

lines.zh: 铁在我嘴里化开，冒小泡。
lines.en: The iron dissolves in my mouth with tiny bubbles.
This is iron. Good.
I bit it; my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我都能找到。
lines.en: I can find anything that falls.
I bury it in the soil.
Not enough for my shell to grow.
You've stood beside me too long.
My feelers are all raised.

lines.zh: 我把软身子一寸寸扭过来。
lines.en: I twist my soft body around inch by inch.
The stone by your feet is bubbling.
Stop backing; there's a wall.
My acid has already flowed there.

lines.zh: 你每落一脚，我就缩一下。
lines.en: Each footfall makes me flinch.
Your soles won't last.

lines.zh: 我抬起来的其实只有触须。
lines.en: Only my feelers rise.

lines.zh: 我的黏液把地面弄滑了。
lines.en: My slime slicks the floor.

lines.zh: 你退得很快，但你还要回来。
lines.en: You back fast, but you'll have to return.
I crawl along your footprints.
My shell grinds on stone.
That bubbling is acid at my shell.
My acid is flowing your way.
You lean on a wall that is dissolving.

lines.zh: 再爬半寸，酸就滴到你鞋。
lines.en: Half an inch more and acid drips on your shoe.
I stretch my body long.
You're standing on me.

lines.zh: 酸已经流到你鞋底下了。
lines.en: The acid reached your sole.

lines.zh: 酸从壳口滴到你手背上。
lines.en: Acid drips onto the back of your hand.
I ram you with my shell.
Slow, but it clings.
I bite your shoe.

lines.zh: 我黏在你裤脚上，甩不掉。
lines.en: I'm stuck to your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 细触须绕住你两根手指。
lines.en: Fine feelers wrap two of your fingers.
You feel a burn.
I let go and cling again.
I slip under your foot.
The stone here is edible.
My acid burns a mark on the ground.
I uncoil my body flat.
I hear water far off.

lines.zh: 我选了一块潮湿的石头。
lines.en: I chose a damp stone.
Tentacles leave the crack first, shell after.
I start crawling toward the stone.

lines.zh: 溶洞里醒来，铁的味道正好。
lines.en: Waking in these caves, the smell of iron suits me.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，我蜷紧了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell and I coil tight.
I fell and my shell cracked.

lines.zh: 水把酸冲淡了，我很不舒服。
lines.en: Water dilutes my acid; I feel wrong.
The blast tosses me up.
Spell-light chills my acid.
Without iron, my shell won't grow.

lines.zh: 雷打过我的壳，我麻了半天。
lines.en: Lightning hit my shell; I was numb a long while.
No stone; I fall.
